data.indexCnDesc: 中证全指软件指数从中证全指指数中选取业务涉及软件开发领域的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映该主题上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI All Share Software Index selects the securities whose business involves software field from the universe of CSI All Share Index as index constituents. The index is to measure the overall performance of software companies.
